versions.content: The ECU Manager module shall define a configurable set of reset causes (see EcuMShutdownCause and EcuM_ShutdownCauseType ). The set shall minimally contain targets for • ECU state machine entered a shutdown state • WdgM detected a failure • DCM requests shutdownI and the time of the reset.
